reviews.title: Absolute scam
reviews.text:
I paid €13 for the trial period, thinking I would receive my aura reading as stated in the Instagram advertisement. After paying, I discovered that I had to pay €29.99 to get the reading, so I decided to subscribe to receive it — and if I liked it, I planned to continue the subscription. However, I then found out that the reading analysis takes 8 days, which means it arrives right after the trial period ends, effectively forcing you to pay for both the trial and the subscription. This felt very misleading.

They also offered me €10 in exchange for giving a 5-star review, which means many of those five-star reviews are fake and paid for.

I do not recommend this to anyone.

reviews.title: BEWARE
reviews.text: I ordered a one-time purchase for one euro. A huge mistake. I never received it. They say they don’t even provide such service. Two weeks later I was charged for €39 from my bank account. I immediately contacted the company to ask for help and for a refund. I was being super careful what I signed for with that 1€ ”deal”, and they ADMITTED that there isn’t a mark for ”agreed” direct debit on my paypal or Apple store. That I should have known to check their site to cancel something I didn’t even know existed, a little dodgy would you say? I’ve opened a case with paypal, and have been pestered by several copy-paste e-mails insulting me and refusing to refund my money. I have no clue what this 39€ even stands for, I have no clue what I ”ordered”. And instead of being reputable and respectable, they insist keeping someone’s money for doing literally nothing. How does that work, eh? 39€ is a lot of money. I have sent them screenshots of my email, and no such recipes or reminders to cancel my discription exist they claimed to have sent me, all I have is daily horoscopes, which again I didn’t order. BEWARE!
